newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE to list options on Imperial Tobacco, Oct 1.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE to list options on Imperial Tobacco, Oct 1.

text.p: The London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) said that equity options on shares of Imperial Tobacco Group Plc will be available from October 1 following the demerger of Hanson Plc.
LIFFE currently lists traded options on Hanson which intends to demerge in two phases to form four separate companies.
The first phase will involve the demerger of Millennium Chemicals Inc and Imperial Tobacco Group Plc and is scheduled to take place on October 1.
The second phase will involve the the demerger of the Energy Group Plc and is scheduled for early 1997.

Existing traded options on Hanson will be adjusted by LIFFE to reflect the demergers of Millennium Chemicals and Imperial Tobacco and existing November 1996 and February 1997 options series in Hanson will continue to be listed.
Imperial Tobacco shares will be listed on the London Stock Exchange and Millennium Chemicals common stock will be listed on the New York Stock Exchange.
